text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One holiday.
Having finished her errands near the station, Narita Taishin was walking back to the academy, when—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the limited character for "Animal Hunt"
spawns around here, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Might as well catch it while I'm at it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nothing's showing up on the radar yet, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What is this—'Caution: Wet Concrete.
Watch your step'?!"

text_block_list.name: Construction Man
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to say it, but these boots are beyond saving.
Tough luck, little lady.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (My right foot's still barefoot... How am I gonna get home?)
choice_data_list: Huh? Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Construction Man
text_block_list.text: D-Do you know this young lady? She just stepped right into some wet concrete with her right foot...

text_block_list.name: Construction Man
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'm glad someone you know is here.
Get home safe, little lady!”

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The construction worker waved goodbye to the blushing Narita Taishin before walking away.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I don't need any help, okay?
Leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having said that,
it'll probably be hard for her to make it back to the dorm on her own.
choice_data_list: I'll go buy some shoes.
I'll go buy the shoes!
Let me help you walk to the shoe store.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having said that,
it'll probably be hard for her to make it back to the dorm on her own.
choice_data_list: I'll go buy some shoes.
I'll go buy the shoes!
Let me help you walk to the shoe store.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Like I said, I don't need your help.
choice_data_list: Should we contact the dorm, then?
Should we contact the dorm, then?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
N-No!
That'll just make things even more troublesome, won't it!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*
Fine. I'll give you the money, so go buy it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having received her consent,
I had Narita Taishin rest at a nearby park and hurried off to the shoe store."

text_block_list.name: Shoe Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
This kind is perfect for young folks these days!
They're super easy to run in, so they come highly recommended!

text_block_list.name: Shoe Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
It'll go perfectly with the street fashion
you mentioned, too!
choice_data_list: I see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the saleswoman's glowing endorsement,
I felt confident it was the right choice
and decided to buy the recommended shoes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, when I met up with Narita Taishin
and reported that I had bought the shoes—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yeah.
That was a lifesaver—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait, what are those super cute shoes?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That's totally out of character for me...!
You know that, right!?
choice_data_list: Apparently it goes well with street fashion too.
Apparently it goes well with street fashion too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...So you just bought into the clerk's sales pitch, huh?
Well, I'll try them on for now, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Actually, now that I'm wearing them...
they might not be so bad after all?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.
choice_data_list: It looks great on you, Taishin!
It looks great on you, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"I-I don't need any flattery.
...As long as it doesn't look weird, that's good enough for me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Despite Narita Taishin's blunt attitude—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, Taishin-chan.
Are you heading out~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You've completely fallen in love with your new shoes, haven't you~♪
They match perfectly with your outfit today, too~

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait, r-really?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah... maybe.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I don't need it!
I'd rather hop on one leg than lean on your shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hup, whoa... Woah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Narita Taishin tried to hop forward on one foot,
but after a few steps, she tottered and lost her balance."
choice_data_list: It really is dangerous! Hold on!
It really is dangerous! Hold on!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ......Yeah, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, Narita Taishin held onto my shoulder, albeit reluctantly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After walking together for a while,
we passed by a park, so we decided
to take a rest on a bench.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, what were you doing over there?
Come to think of it, what were you doing over there?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
......A game.
One that uses location data.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Apparently, the game she was playing involves physically going to real-world locations to collect characters placed on a map identical to reality.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Apparently, she was trying to collect limited-edition characters while she was stopping by the station.
choice_data_list: Then we might find it while we're walking around.
Then we might find it while we're walking around.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No way.
As if things could ever be that easy—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No way!
A blip on the radar...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems what we're looking for has actually appeared.
After getting the coordinates, it looks like the spawn location isn't far from here.
choice_data_list: It's super close, so let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: I gotta blow off steam about ruining my shoes!
I'm venting my frustration over ruining my shoes!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If that's how you see it, maybe it works.
It'd suck to just go home after having a bad time anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
Now that it's decided, I'm definitely catching it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lending a shoulder to a nodding Narita Taishin,
we made our way to where the character was supposed to appear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—
thanks to everyone's cooperation, it looks like
Narita Taishin was able to obtain the limited character.
choice_data_list: Congratulations, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well... yeah.
I feel a little better now, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, taking breaks along the way, we headed to the shoe store.
From buying the shoes until we parted ways,
Narita Taishin seemed to be in a slightly better mood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through that series of collaborative tasks,
I felt like I had become just a little closer with her.
